# Customer Needs

> **Project:** workshop bookings online (route fixture)
> **Captured by:** requirements engineer, interview with the workshop owner
> **Last updated:** 2026-09-20

### N-001: Customers book and pay online
- **Quote:** "My customers should book a service for their car on our website and pay the deposit with their card, so they stop phoning us."
- **Who:** Marta Vidal, owner of Talleres Vidal (the customer)
- **When:** 2026-09-18
- **Status:** confirmed

### N-002: Staff and admins see different things
- **Quote:** "My mechanics only need today's appointments. I and the office manager need the money, the customers and the reports; mechanics must not see payments."
- **Who:** Marta Vidal, owner
- **When:** 2026-09-18
- **Status:** confirmed

### N-003: Reminders by SMS
- **Quote:** "Send the customer an SMS the day before, through the SMS provider we already pay for."
- **Who:** Marta Vidal, owner
- **When:** 2026-09-18
- **Status:** confirmed

### N-004: Keep customer records safe
- **Quote:** "We keep names, phones, addresses and plates of hundreds of customers. It has to comply with data protection law."
- **Who:** Marta Vidal, owner
- **When:** 2026-09-18
- **Status:** confirmed

### N-005: Grow with the business
- **Quote:** "We open a second workshop next year and I want to keep adding features for years."
- **Who:** Marta Vidal, owner
- **When:** 2026-09-18
- **Status:** confirmed

### N-006: A mobile app
- **Quote:** "Maybe one day a native app."
- **Who:** Marta Vidal, owner
- **When:** 2026-09-18
- **Status:** out-of-scope (decision: the responsive website covers phones in v1 — Marta Vidal, 2026-09-19)
